authorship: New AI-generated raster art prompted and conditioned for Blackout. Source images are retained verbatim. Native pixel cleanup, palette restriction, frame assembly and animation derivation are explicitly disclosed.
rightsStatement: Generated for this project using user-provided visual references. No third-party asset pack or license claim is included; this record does not assert exclusivity or event eligibility.

generations.notes: Requested 1024x1024 source; built-in returned 1254x1254. Runtime exports independently normalize exact dimensions.

references.role: user-provided style reference; source UI not copied into runtime

sourceFormat: source/sprites.json stores one integer palette index per native pixel; -1 is transparent. It is editable without an art application. Original raster is also editable in pixel editors.
statePolicy: Chassis indicators are neutral gray. No warning, outage or operation is baked into machine pixels. Named badges are separate overlays for the renderer to select from permitted observations.
collisionPolicy: footprint is art extent in logical pixels, not collision truth. Scenario geometry alone controls collision. Fan subparts and decorative infrastructure have null footprints.
proofBoundary: Static art exports and offline custody checks. Runtime rendering, observation gating, mission-clock animation and user visual acceptance require coordinator integration and review.
